newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez to sell Dauphin-OTA stake.
newsitem.headline: Suez to sell Dauphin-OTA stake.

text.p: Suez Industrie said on Wednesday it planned to sell its 10.05 percent stake in poster and advertising firm Dauphin-OTA depending on market conditions.

"Suez Industrie has informed the stock exchange authorities that it intends to sell its 10.05 percent stake in Dauphin-OTA on the condition that market conditions are favourable," it said in a statement.
